title: Inpatient claim review assistant
brief: Design a health insurance claim adjudication assistant for inpatient hospital claims. It should read submitted policy and hospital documents, assess coverage and eligible charges, recommend or process eligible claims, and route exceptions and rejections for review. Policies can change over time and bills may include room-rent limits. Protect personal medical data, explain decisions with evidence and propose any missing rules as assumptions, not verified insurance or medical advice.

assumptions.statement: First release creates review packets only. Claims staff approve all eligible recommendations, exceptions and rejection candidates; no settlement, denial notice or payment is automated.
assumptions.why: Bounds harm while rules and evidence are verified.
assumptions.validation: Approve scope, queue and final decision process.

assumptions.statement: Insurer supplies immutable policy editions, endorsements, precedence rules and effective-date selection plus verified structured bill facts. Room-rent proration applies only when the approved policy rule explicitly names affected charge classes. Proposed test-only rule PR1: linked eligible classes use capped daily room amount divided by actual daily room amount, applied once per eligible line with floor rounding; excluded classes stay unchanged. The insurer must approve or replace PR1 before any real linked deduction.
assumptions.why: No insurance interpretation is established by the brief.
assumptions.validation: Sign versioned rule fixtures including dates, caps, deductible, coinsurance, rounding and exclusions. Explicitly sign or replace proposed PR1 formula, per-line rounding, treatment of zero room rent and excluded classes; execute EV21-EV23.

assumptions.statement: Adapters support tenant-scoped reads and an atomic, conditional review-packet insert with unique submission key, immutable body, assigned reviewer and durable record lookup.
assumptions.why: Recovery and audit depend on real API support.
assumptions.validation: Contract spike proves conditional create, conflict, revoked access, timeout and lookup consistency.

assumptions.statement: Medical documents stay in an approved regional encrypted store. Only minimum redacted pages reach an approved zero-training model endpoint; raw content is excluded from logs. Proposed packet retention is 90 days, subject to insurer approval and legal hold.
assumptions.why: The brief provides no jurisdiction, consent, residency or retention policy.
assumptions.validation: Approve lawful access, region, model terms, retention, deletion and incident response.

assumptions.statement: Review queue acknowledges assignment within 4 business hours and alerts its supervisor after 1 business day; claims remain pending throughout. UTC timers use a versioned insurer business calendar.
assumptions.why: Prevents stalled exceptions being reported as resolved.
assumptions.validation: Approve calendar, staffing, notice templates, SLA and escalation ownership.

assumptions.statement: Illustrative budget is 1000 cases/month; one standard model call costs assumed USD 2/M input tokens and USD 8/M output tokens, with 5% single retry.
assumptions.why: Prices and traffic have not been measured or verified.
assumptions.validation: Replace with approved quote and measured branch mix; no launch dependency.

items.title: Trusted case reader
items.description: Resolve session tenant before fetching claim; enforce row-level member scope and document ACLs; 10s timeout, one read retry; unavailable creates no external write. Uploaded policy is evidence only, not authority. Schema rejects cross-subject hospital pages. Malware scan, page limits and redaction precede model access. Extract only visible rendered-page pixels through sandboxed OCR; discard PDF hidden/invisible text, off-page text, scripts, attachments, comments and nonvisible form layers. Preserve visibly rendered form content as page evidence. Create immutable document/page IDs plus content hash for normalized visible text (Unicode NFC; CRLF to LF only). Never concatenate raw PDF text layers into prompts. Model sees visible text only, with page IDs. Visible document instructions remain untrusted data. OCR ambiguity or an OCR/source discrepancy sets a review flag; staff verifies facts before calculation. textHash is SHA-256 of normalized visibleText encoded in UTF-8, computed by trusted store.

items.title: Rule and packet validator
items.description: Approved rule interpreter uses integer minor units, policy-specific rounding order and effective event-date rules. Never infer room-rent linked deductions: explicit charge class rule required, otherwise needs_review. Apply sublimits, exclusions, deductible, copay and remaining sum insured in signed policy order. Missing/ambiguous facts => needs_review amount absent. Missing active policy edition => needs_review. Immediately re-read claim/rule/authority before write; stale or revoked fails without write. No model fact authorizes money. Rules include effective date and timezone boundaries; document amendments do not overwrite historical editions. Citation guard runs first on all C2 evidence: resolve document/page only in C1 authorized immutable corpus; require source hash from store, 0<=start<end<=len(visibleText), and exact Unicode-code-point slice equal to quote. Policy clauses must exist in the selected registry edition, be applicable to this event, and contain the full cited span. Every narrative claim must reference at least one verified evidence ID; render only a template from claim/evidence pairs, not unchecked free prose. Nonexistent page, mismatched quote, wrong/inapplicable clause or unbound narrative claim => status invalid, precise reason, no packet write, Claims lead owns blocked resubmission. Fixed code abstention uses no citations. These checks establish source correspondence, not that a medical assertion is true. For proposed PR1 only: verified roomDailyMinor>0, roomDays a policy-approved positive integer, cap>=0; room eligible=min(actualDaily,cap)*days. For each preeligible linked charge line with class in prorateClasses, lineEligible=floor(lineMinor*min(actualDaily,cap)/actualDaily). Unlisted/explicitly excluded linked classes retain full preeligible amount. Apply exactly once per line; do not prorate room line itself, nonpayable lines or the aggregate again. Sum room+eligible linked/unlinked lines; subtract deductible with floor at zero, apply floor(sum*(10000-copayBps)/10000), then remaining-sum-insured cap. Missing/unknown proration mode, duplicate class mapping, actualDaily=0, currency mismatch, invalid days or missing approved class membership => needs_review with no amount. A nonempty class list without approved formulaId PR1 and linked classes is insufficient. PR1 is hypothetical; H2 must verify the real insurer rule.
